data.body: **[P2] Update the public `OperationInfo.error` contract.** This now returns `undefined` for failed operations with an empty wire error, while `types/plugin.ts` promises that `error` is present on failed operations regardless of the lifecycle hook. Existing API-v1 plugins may use that documented field as their failure signal and silently miss these failures. Update the public JSDoc/API documentation and compatibility notes to define this absence case, or preserve the existing guarantee through a separate metadata-presence signal.
